_comment: Example custom theme for Claude Agent SDK
_usage: Reference this in config.json or load programmatically: Theme.from_dict(json.load(...))
_description: This demonstrates how to create a fully custom theme from scratch
name: custom_corporate
_name_note: Give your theme a descriptive name

user_message._note: Make user messages stand out with bold blue

assistant_message._note: Assistant responses in green for easy scanning

system_message._note: System messages are informational, so dimmed yellow

tool_use._note: Tool calls in italic cyan to show they're actions

tool_result._note: Tool results in plain white for readability

tool_error._note: Errors need maximum visibility: bold + underline + red

bullet._note: Bullets match tool_use color for visual consistency

tree_connector._note: Tree lines are subtle, dimmed to not distract

truncation._note: Truncation notices in italic yellow to draw attention

code_block._note: Code blocks in cyan (future syntax highlighting will override this)

thinking._note: Thinking blocks in italic magenta to show internal reasoning

cost_display._note: Cost info in yellow as it's important but not critical

_color_formats._note: Colors can be specified in multiple formats:
_color_formats._rgb_note: RGB tuples work in truecolor terminals: [255, 128, 0] = orange

_style_options.italic: true/false - italicizes text (not all terminals support)
_style_options.bg_color: background color (rarely needed, can reduce readability)

_best_practices.semantic_meaning: Use colors consistently - red=error, green=success, blue=info
_best_practices.accessibility: Combine color with style (bold/underline) so info isn't lost without color
_best_practices.contrast: Ensure fg_color contrasts with terminal background (test light & dark terminals)
_best_practices.consistency: Match your color scheme - don't mix warm and cool colors randomly
_best_practices.restraint: Don't use bg_color unless necessary - can clash with user's terminal theme

verify: Test with --no-color flag to ensure graceful degradation
